issues.explanation: «تحمل ریسک» does not appear in any cited INSO printed evidence. The only INSO-printed forms are «سطح رواداری مخاطره» (INSO 23728 clause 8.1, confirmed in evidence text) and, per the editor note, «رواداری مخاطره» (clause 7.3.2). Rule 1 requires the preferred Persian term to equal what the cited standard prints. Selecting «تحمل ریسک» — which exists solely in the NIST-translation context of this book — as preferred_fa over the INSO-printed forms is not justified; the editor note itself admits the choice is still open.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «رواداری مخاطره» (the shorter INSO-printed base form, noting its appearance in INSO 23728 clause 7.3.2) or «سطح رواداری مخاطره» (clause 8.1); move «تحمل ریسک» to alternatives_fa labelled as the NIST-translation form used in the translated sections of this book. Resolve the open choice before approving the entry.

issues.explanation: «سامانه مدیریت هوش مصنوعی» is listed in alternatives_fa, but INSO 42001 clause 1 footnote 1 (printed evidence) explicitly reserves «سامانه» for the AI-technology context (a deployed AI system) and «نظام» for the management context. An AI Management System is a management framework, so the standard's own normalization rules require «نظام». Listing «سامانه مدیریت» as an acceptable alternative contradicts that printed ruling and could be read as endorsing a form the standard itself rejects within this domain.
issues.suggested_fix: Move «سامانه مدیریت هوش مصنوعی» (and, for the same reason, «سیستم مدیریت هوش مصنوعی») to rejected_fa with the explanation that INSO 42001 clause 1 note 1 explicitly assigns «نظام» to the management context and «سامانه» to the AI-technology context.
